sloka: स लङ्घयित्वा प्राकारं गिरिकूटोपमो महान्।निर्ययौ नगरात्तूर्णं कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः ।। ६.६६.१ ।।
transliteration: sa laṅghayitvā prākāraṁ girikūṭopamo mahān।niryayau nagarāttūrṇaṁ kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ ।। 6.66.1 ।।

translations.english: Mighty Kumbhakarna, a gigantic one, resembling a mountain peak, having swiftly crossed over the boundary of the city roared.
